text: Game is pretty addicting at first. The story aspect of it dies out very very quickly and there's nothing past the first 30 minutes. However, the biggest deal breaker for me is that as soon as the 'beginner shield' that protects new players from pvp went down, I was attacked constantly and remained at zero resources. Pretty trash game to be honest. Also, if you saw the really cute tree base ad or the train ad, this game is nothing like what you saw in the ads.

Enjoy the game, but purchases help a LOT! I don't like the wait times to upgrade places. It should be combined. Do it all at once, log in after a cumaltive number of hours. I cannot log in every hour. The game is fun but there are too many things going on, simultaneously. Can't keep track of the 20 odd events and pop ups. A Nice game, I thought it was more of building my village... but it is more a Multiplayer game. Note the pictures are nothing like the game. You will get bored quick, sadly!!!

So far, after a day, the game is fun, a little £££ based at times, but they all are. After 8 days, I'm Lvl14, and it's by far the hardest game to navigate... menu's and structure are leaving me frustrated... I've already had to email the developers regarding a purchase and not receiving things I should of. I've already had enough, which is such a shame because I'm in a good alliance and mingling with good people. Notifications are the worst I've seen in a game, and I've played really good ones.

game progress resets. I played this game a LOT before. came back after a bit to find my progress completely reset and back to the beginning. Very annoying, begrudgingly started again just for the same thing to happen again. When I retried the first time it was on a completely different device. Don't install, it's not worth wasting your time like that.

Starts strong then the story ends and it's just like every other game. You must join an alliance, you can't opt out. Customer service is AI. Attack mechanics of villages means they can just follow you around the map attacking every 5 minutes. Stopped being fun, so I'm deleting it. Not a game I'd recommend. If it removed the entire multilayer aspect (if I wanted that, I'd buy a console) and focused on just the story line then it would be a decent phone game

Games good fun, but the support is truly awful. I lost a phone and thought that reinstalling the game and logging back in would restore my account and purchases. But no, it doesn't always and didn't for me. Been trying to get help to recover my account for 4 weeks now and they respond once or twice a week, ask me the same questions each time or close my case without solving the problem. So here I am, 4 weeks since the issue and no further forward.... Really poor for a "pay as you go" game!

The game is visually quite nice and game play is easy to do. However the amount of money you have to spend on this game is ridiculous. So many battle passes, Construction passes, Speed passes ect. I had a fantastic alliance 4th on the server and I decided to step down as the leader and leave the game. The reason why is all of the above, You have to P2W no other way to complete. Cya Dark was fun whilst it lasted.

I had it previously installed. I'm not giving it 3 stars because the game is bad, only because the ad is nothing like the game. To break it down for you, it's similar to many other games. You have either a furnace in the middle or some campfire. You upgrade the buildings around, upgrade skills, build other buildings, train troops, and find heroes. Also, you accept new survivors into the camp/base. It's the same game, "repacked," with a "different story," but the mechanics are the same.

Good start to game, nice story line but ends at chapter 10 which is a shame, similar to whiteout survival but with more components which is nice, there is a few issues, everything is expensive, so unless you have a money tree growing in your back garden keeping up with other players who pay to play you will lose troops, there is no limit to how many times you are attacked so I suggest keeping hold of your rubies for shields if you don't want to lose, I could go on but only have 500 characters

The game was always a little P2W but now they have stopped item crafting. This means 1 piece of legendary equipment costs £50!! You require four pieces per hero! That's £200 per hero to get the same items you could get for free (with a fair amount of work) a week prior. Absolutely shocking and disgraceful Money grabbing. To the extreme! Stay away until they respect the people who pay their bills!

Played this for over a year. Whilst I didn't mind a slow grind, buy buttons don't need to be strategically placed and have tonnes of pop ups to buy this and that... It's a cash grab. New and free players will eventually get to industry levels where everything you have counts and you'll just deplete it all as it really isn't made for those that don't spend. The reset times make it hard to get all rewards if you can't hit their stupid timezone. States barely work as a community half the time.

It's okay, massively depends on a good alliance. too many popups when you open the game - you're being attacked live but fighting through popups to defend/bubble it's very frustrating in general nevermind when under attack. Not very good instructions and guides, like I had no idea radar events run out and you build them by completing and not collecting? I had to find out from Reddit. Another annoying thing is the app icon, it's a square in a circle on a Pixel! it needs updating to fill it in

Been playing for about 1-2 months. Its a very busy game full of tasks, it can keep you busy for hours a day. Not necessary to pay 2 play but if you want to be one of the best its obvious that you need to be in the best alliance AND you need to buy packs (occasionally). But its a good game and i think its better than other similar base/adventure games, that i was in for 3+ years. This one seems less pressurising (for the moment) and fun to play so ik happy for the moment. I recommend trying it.

Good game, unfortunately nothing like the pictures so don't go off them. Looks like a shelter game but it's not, it's more off white out survival but more advanced. The game itself is good but the downside is the wait time on buildings and structures. Once you get to a certain point there is no point in playing as your just waiting for your things to upgrade for hours with nothing else meaningful to do. Up until that point worth a play.

Enjoyable - but looks nothing like the adverts. The same as other games in there being lots to pay for, but you can carry on for free without those things. As a result, I have Rex sat at my watchtower permanently because I won't pay 9.99 to 'heal' him and get extras. Advert showed a shelter built under ground with many levels, that's what drew me in - there isn't one. At a certain level it becomes similar to most other games - upgrade buildings, gathering, rallies, killing zombies on radar.

Not very friendly for Free To Play. Horrendous pay wall right from the start. Doesn't look anything like the advertisements on YouTube either. Gave it a week but like so many other games of this type, forgetting to set your shield on your colony is very costly, and a pain to be honest. Good graphics, but gameplay is too similar to other games - Puzzles and Survival and Myths of Moonrise come to mind; upgrade buildings, gather resources, collect character shards

Pay to win. I've logged into this game for 150 days in a row, so I feel like 5 months is long enough for me to give an honest review. At first, it's fun. There's lots to do and learn. Eventually, you'll reach a level when you start to get raided. So you join a clan. There is no limit on how many times 1 player can raid you. I have been raided multiple times by 1 single player until they've emptied your resources. The only protection is a shield that costs gems - the premium game currency 👎

Just like the rest. Watch thousands of ads or pay. Don't wast your time. 3 seconds. 1 minute. 15 mins then 1 hour and onto 78 hours. Nothing like the adverts make out or the images show on here. Complete waste of time. Sooo disappointed as I really wanted to experience what the ads show. If could give it less stars I would.

The visuals are average, the story is boring (and also probably written by AI) and none of the characters are memorable. Basically it's unoriginal AI slop that uses AI ads to make it look more interesting than it is. There's a bunch of similar mobile games that at least have people putting in hard work. Do not recommend, it's nothing special or worth your time.

Boring game now, the devs keep changing pointless things in it and there is just no reason to play anymore, it use to be a war game, now it's just a chat room with upgrades, many people are logging in less and less or quitting so the chats are basically empty these days. It was a fun game, bit of a money grab at times, you need to be prepared to spend weeks on upgrades if you aren't spending a fortune, and when you think you are getting somewhere they release an update that sets you back.

Couldn't use variable hero fragments so reinstalled the game to see if that fixed it but it said my email was invalid to access my account, even though I had made purchases with receipts to my email. Just be aware that if you change devices or have to reinstall, you may not get back in. I can't be bothered with this kind of thing. Luckily I didn't spend much but I dropped the game immediately. There are plenty of similar games I could invest time in.

Very glitchy, lags a LOT and even leaves the game to go to the previous app you were using. I've logged issues with their customer service twice and never had a reply. Initial Storyline/gameplay was good but gets very boring unless you want to spend a lot of money. Storyline then becomes non-existent and you can't do anything as there will always be players more powerful than you. It's really a levelling up game with tasks small/mini games, also with the advantage going to those who pay!

Looks nothing like the ads. Totally generic, about 40 minutes of "story" and dialog, then it's just a repeat of "wait for resources>build something to get more resources>repeat" with the occasional "raid other towns" and "loot box for heros". This thing is such a carbon copy of other games many of the sprites, character art and stylings are literally copied and pasted into this 'game'. Total trash.

Your typical pay to win real time based strategy game... Short term it's fun but after that it's just expensive and not worth it, unless want to spend £20 per day to keep up with the big dogs (around half the player count) don't waste your money buy a game that's all inclusive either that or they charge the west a premium... Also the art work they show has nothing to do with the game (typical)

Hello everyone, This game is going through major updates weekly, which makes the gameplay really bad, I have invested a lot into the game and to get ahead of a lot of people. Every week or so they change the parameters of the game which means anything you have bought before reduces in value. You buy hero shards to get a certain skill, and they will nerf the skill tomorrow. So the items I bought aren't what they were sold as, I would recommend being very careful.

Ugh, another base building game with nothing like the actual ads. Then again they used ai slop to generate the trailers so shouldn't really be surprised. The copy paste excuse that they're trying to give a idea of the core theme of the game is dishonest saying it represents the base theme. Particularly as the ad represents gameplay like footage. Will be reporting to the ASA.

If there's one thing I hate, it's when the ad is far removed from the actual game. This is being presented in the ad as Japanese style Spirited Awayesque animation and it does not resemble the artwork or game style in any way shape or form, so far removed. I just wasted 10 minutes of my life to find out. Just don't do it.

This game is one of the worst where you have to spend to get certain rewards which you can't get as a free to play no matter how much your try. You can't get few of the S teir players without spending money, not to mention you will get a second builder if you are spending money so your progress is already 2x of the normal player regardless of the all the other rewards which you get.

So i saw the ad on Facebook and decided to check it out on the Play Store. The moment i saw the images, it was clear the devs refused to show any actual in-game screenshots and such, so I then searched it up on YouTube, and to no surprise, the game looks nothing like anything presented in the images. It's basically a whiteout survival copy.

False advertisement. The game is nothing like the Ad. The game is nothing like the description in playstore. The game tried selling me microtrasactions before revealing what type game it is (as till that point you are just clicking what you are shown). In general... The game is a standard build a town attack other players for recourses game. Decent graphics and looks like there is some minimal story behind. But I hate this type of games and being blatantly lied to for 30m does not help the case

don't do it. the minute you find Rex the dog you have to pay almost 10 quid/dollars whatever to heal him and rank up Cat, however you cut it this is a pay to play game and everything you have to pay for shakes it's bubble and red dot at you the whole time you play, it's another game that's nothing like the ads and really a huge waste of time and money's, honestly, save up, buy a switch or some other handheld and play animal crossing or cities skylines or something. it'd be money better spent.

I had to delete game, unfortunately. Been playing for a couple of days, and then it became unplayable. I loaded it up this morning, and the buy Guy for 99p came up and would not let me close it. And at the same time, the story for the people that came back from finding the generator kept repeating again and again. Was enjoying it until then.

Overall it's an amazing game with a lot of promise and potential, but as with alot of games of this style and genre it's a massive cash grab, pay walls will more or less keep you so under level it's barely worth playing for free. In addition to all the purchasing often the rewards for doing such do not constitute the excessive pricetag. So to summarise, another potentially awesome game ruined by greedy developers and a monetisation policy that would make EA Games blush.

Good over all game... but the fact you have to pay to recieve any gold characters is a serious flaw. It almost forces your hand to spend money if you want to have the most competitive characters. Was really enjoying it but the more characters that come out. The more money you have to pay to get them. Make people pay for extra.... not the characters.

So far a fun game. It can be a little confusing and im worried it's gonna end up like all these pay to win strategy games. But for now it's been chill, free and fun. Edit: so yeah, I'm past the very early stuff and now I'm onto the world map I don't have the time or energy to deal with being raided all the time However give it a try it may be for you.

Nice, but the game will die soon as there are alliances that have much stronger players (who spend ton of RL money to advance) constantly attack same players over and over again. Once my shield expires (and because even getting 24h shield cost a lot) and I get bombarded with attacks by the same player, I might start getting on the game less often... Also, there's no option to report a player once you click on them, so can't even let the developers know about the abusers...

Update 6/4/25: Well, they have made the game ridiculously harder for no reason! it was already getting silly with the outrageous amount of rrs to lvl watchtower, now they have ruined the lvling of the heros! It was a great game where you didn't have to pay to play. and although a bit challenging it was good. but now, its full cash grab. its impossible to level. such a shame. I loved this game! from 5 stars to 1. hopefully they will go back to the original that was fantastic! Gutted.

Not for poor people. This game is dominated by rich players. It's a pay to win game. Grinding day by day isn't worth it. People literally have pay for everything, every event, every hero's upgrade. If you are someone who just wanna play without spending, this game isn't for you. It might take years to build a decent profile but someone can literally pay and achieve it within a few weeks. For normal players, you won't achieve anything. Some high level players will come and dominate over you easy

Even though I knew it wouldn't look like the anime advert or play the way it was advertised I got curious. It doesn't really even resemble the pictures they use before you download on the google play app. Thing is the game art is nice its own right and if it had been advertised honestly showing the actual art and gameplay I would have been more inclinded to try sooner and keep. As it is I deleted the app. If you can't be upfront about what the game is actually like what else are hiding?

really good game. keeps you engaged. amazing how you have the building part and the online war part in 1 I think it's definitely a game that you will get addicted too. 5 stars for the game itself. good online events and control. only issue with this game. the reason I gave it 3 stars is the unbelievable amount of things you have to pay for. now I understand pay for play is in every game like this but it is extremely too much for what you get. 200 pound nearly for a town skin. no thanks 3*

So ... And pop up to buy it at shop. 4) To much pop ups. To be honest it would be nice game, it looks alright and the theme is alright, however this seems like reskin of hundreds other games which hunting on your wallet.

so far so good. slightly annoying that to advance past Level 7 watchtower I had to buy a bundle otherwise I was relying on chance to get past it. would be worth while having an increase in % to get characters with tickets. everything else is good. easy to play, fun side games too which is good. and the upgrades take minimal time which is great

Was a decent start, but hitting chapter 10 ends any form of "story" and you're just left grinding the game out for seemingly no point. Resources are as overly hard to get as other games of this genre which is nice, but I'd like a bit more varied content and a few less play walls (3 season passes on at once is a bit too greedy)

Meh! False advertising, pictures of the game ie Day # of the apocalypse. Do not represent the game at all. Another of generic game where it draws you in quickly, then if you want to progress at the same rate, you have to pay. You can still make progress in the game, but it is so slow.

I have played this game for 10 months now. now in Season4(5) Bugs are crazy. there is new one all the time,never ending! Its a good game. At first, its pay to win, but as each season goes by it becomes pay to play. £40 per month is ideal. Killing "monsters" becomes more difficult each passing season. Items are more expensive than they should be. Unfair prices varies per country. Help desk is very poor. Discord helps a lot. Ranking it 4/10. (Yes I also spent money to play)

Wasn't as advertised, it's advertised as a multiplayer game where the goal is to get a room and survive, but when I started, it was immediately story based and gave tasks to do, so I left the game. If you want to advertise your game, don't falsely advertise it, just advertise yourself as a whiteout survival rip-off like you are smh.

A very Pay to Win game with some players spending thousands. The ads for spending are many and frequent and can be annoying for Free to Play players. Very addictive and well thought out game that has lead to some players over spending and quitting the game over mental issues. The graphics are good with fun gameplay. Losses are limited so you can't be zeroed, just temporarily out of action until healing of troops.

Greed beyond bounds. The monetisation in this game is absurd. The requirement to spend becomes clear as you progress through the game and get constantly bombarded with packages and weekly spending "events". Don't play it if you value your wallet as you can easily end up spending hundreds in macrotransactions.

I genuinely only installed this to say that I wish there was a way to report apps for false advertising because this game is the absplute king of it. I knew straight away based on the awful ads of this game with their AI videos that it was some devious move to get people to install this boring grind of a game by falsely showing that it's got some rip off Ghibli art style. If I'm gonna see this game's ads so much, at least pay someone to make good ads for it instead of getting an AI to do them.

This looks nothing like the pixel art In all the adds for it, it looks like an AI built standard gotcha game that looks and plays just like every other game of it's kind, it's fun at the start for a bit then you understand the basic loop that will have you waiting and paying to skip, there is absolutely nothing here that's award-winning just AI gen slop.

The game is Pay2Play. I am currently on a 70-day streak, but new players with money can simply buy S class character and bulldoze you. F2P players have access to a SINGEL S class, and that's too after level 18, which took me 15 days, playing over 3 hrs minium daily. The customer support is bad, I have reported vulgar languages in chat, and nothing had been done to fix it. Some events REQUIRES money to be spent just to complete it. And where's the email id of the devs where I can voice complain?

Nice graphics and gameplay. Only just started playing yesterday but it does seem like a pay to play game to expand your town & characters. Before long I can see that larger players who P2P a lot, will destroy the smaller F2P players, making it difficult to progress. Games have unfortunately become like this - the norm, which is just because of greedy developers trying to make a quick buck!

You took everything fun out the game like being able to chop down trees yourself and collecting materials to upgrade. I was hoping the game was abit like The Las Day On Earth...I'm sorry. I know its not what you want to bear but you focused too much on the story and not on the gameplay..I'm sorry but when playing games I like to be in control not the Ai or the system..back to the drawing board

AVOID . Could of been a good game, it's worth playing upto chapter 10 if you feel like wasting some time, but after that it becomes very irritating, everytime to launch the app it asks you for money like a little beggar, while you're clicking on the X button to close the beggar windows down... it takes the fun out of it. It is a copy of games like Ant legion which is another fail money begging game. There are also a few mods you can explore but just be careful where you download from.

The game is made purely to make money, these developers either don't care for gaming or have used AI to create this game! Not at all like any of the advertising for the game, I downloaded it because the pixel artwork was beautiful and I wanted to play it because of it but it is the same rubbish as whiteout survival or that king one that is every second ad. Very disappointing!

There's 15 other games just like it. And probably more. There's way too much to do. Gets overwhelming fast. You feel like you have to pay to play after a certain point. Wouldn't recommend this at all.

game has dialog, forces you to click in one spot, repeat repeat. Doesn't let me play, garbage handholding but good work on graphics and voice acting.

its boring game with a force tutorial that adds nothing to the gameplay. the ads just show pictures of tree houses. it showcases everything this has has for gameplay. which is nothing at all.

I am actually enjoying this.. looking though to see how long it will take till I start purchasing.. I usually try my best not to purchase and play as long as I can. But it makes you want to get those extra perks.
